text:
maria.c: Heads up — Meridian Health scheduled a security deep-dive tomorrow 9:00am PT. They said they will focus on RBAC change history, KMS envelope proof, and how our audit logs are fed to SIEM. Can we gather the short checklist?
kevin.s: I can pull RBAC audit exports. Do we have an agreed retention window for their plan? they specifically asked for 12 months of role change history.
jordan.p: For hosted tenants we keep role change events for 18 months; private deployments can be configured. Will need a permalink to the export pipeline and sample schema.
sasha.l: Quick note — Meridian uses an on-prem SIEM. They'll want examples of syslog/json payloads and field mappings.
maria.c: Right. Also expect questions on KMS envelope flow — customer-managed keys vs our service keys and KMS rotation proof.
oliver: I can produce an HSM key-provenance summary for Private installs. For hosted, we use envelope encryption with AWS KMS/HSM-backed key stores.
kevin.s: Action items: 1) RBAC export (csv + sample query) 2) KMS envelope diagram + rotation proof 3) Sample SIEM payloads and a short retention/archival note. Who owns 1/2/3?
jordan.p: I'll own RBAC export. Will include a sample audit query and a short script to generate CSV. Example query:```sql
SELECT ts, actor_id, actor_email, action, target_type, target_id, prev_value, new_value
FROM audit_events
WHERE action LIKE 'role.%' AND ts >= '2025-03-01T00:00:00Z'
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 1000;
```
sasha.l: I'll prepare SIEM payload samples — syslog and JSON. Example JSON snippet:```json
{ "ts": "2025-04-01T12:34:56Z", "event": "role.update", "actor": "kevin.s@example.com", "role": "admin", "target": "org:12345" }
```
kevin.s: For RBAC export, note: the private deployment schema includes 'tenant_id' and 'cluster_node' fields. I'll add mapping doc.
sec-bot: Reminder: check that any exported logs redact PII by default. Use the redaction helper: `redact_sensitive()` before exporting.
maria.c: Good catch. Meridian asked specifically about email hashes vs raw emails — prefer salted hashes + proof of hashing in export.
jordan.p: I'll add a short appendix showing the hash process and a sample SHA256 salted example: `sha256(salt + email)` and the salt rotation policy.
oliver: For KMS proof, what counts as adequate? They asked for cryptographic evidence of envelope key wrap/unwrapping events and proof of rotation history. We can provide KMS audit events + HSM attestation metadata where available.
sasha.l: For SIEM ingest, Meridian wants guidance on mapping: role.update -> threat.actor.change, severity -> info/low, include original audit IDs so they can query back. I'll prepare a small mapping table.
maria.c: Vulnerability triage / incident response question likely to come up — they want our timeline commitments and what artifacts we provide. Keep it to: initial ack within 1h (SLA), containment plan in 4h, full IR package within 72h for P2.
\ekeep: (typo) ignore
kevin.s: Also surface our retention policy for audit logs and a sample signed export manifest with checksum. I'll generate a sample signed manifest using our internal signing key.
jordan.p: Example manifest lines: `audit-export-20250401.csv, sha256:abcdef1234..., signed-by: redwood-svc-key-v3`
sec-bot: Security checklist: confirm MFA for all admin role changes, verify service accounts have limited scopes, provide evidence of RBAC drift monitoring.
maria.c: Can we get an on-call to join the call? @oliver and @jordan.p should be there. Also @sasha.l for SIEM mapping.
deploy-bot: Deployment note: there's a minor config change rolling at 02:00UTC that touches audit forwarding; will not affect exports. :information_source:
kevin.s: I'll upload RBAC export + sample CSV to the secure share and post link in this thread by EOD.
jordan.p: I'll attach the SQL and a small python script to sanitize and hash emails before export. Snippet:```python
def hash_email(email, salt):
    import hashlib
    return hashlib.sha256((salt + email).encode()).hexdigest()
```
sasha.l: SIEM payloads and mapping doc will be in the same share.
maria.c: Great. Meridian wants a short one-pager at the start of the call summarizing what we can provide. Let's keep it < 1 page: scope, artifacts, timelines, and contact list. I'll draft that and circulate.
oliver: I'll prepare the KMS rotation timeline and HSM attestation notes.
kevin.s: Quick Q: do we want to include live demo of export during the call or stick to prepared artifacts? my vote: prepared artifacts + offer demo if they ask.
maria.c: Agreed. Prepared artifacts first. Demo on request.
sec-bot: Don't forget to log the pre-call checklist in the customer-tracking board.
maria.c: Thanks team. End of thread — ping here once you upload artifacts. :thumbsup:
